name: Lila
source:
Since she was younger Lila has always been a little reserved. Her father an influential politician and her mother at a similar stature, her childhood has always been heavily controlled. She's a little naive but her friends have her back.

She loves swimming and wishes to improve even more. Her first encounter with the Headmaster might have had a bit of an affect on her.
